findings.title: Manifest opt-in boundary accepts missing or wrong orchestration mode
findings.trigger: Call validate_manifest() with a structurally valid EditorialManifestV1 that omits orchestration_mode, uses a wrong orchestration_mode, or carries an extra free-state field.

evidence.summary: Top-level manifest required fields omit orchestration_mode and use subset acceptance.
Candidate tests treat a mode-less manifest as valid.
Architecture requires explicit writer_vnext_opt_in_v1 and says mixed mode without valid manifest fails closed.
WVO-INV-011 requires explicit EditorialManifestV1 mode and no shadow A/B.
missing_orchestration_mode, wrong_orchestration_mode and extra_free_state all return valid=true.

findings.risk: A stale, shadow, partial, or free-state sidecar can be accepted as a valid vNext manifest, breaking the explicit opt-in and schema-drift fail-closed contract before coordinator or Publisher sidecar checks rely on it.
findings.recommended_fix: Require orchestration_mode == writer_vnext_opt_in_v1 in validate_manifest(), reject missing/wrong mode and unexpected free-state top-level fields, then add public negative tests for missing mode, wrong mode and extra fields.
findings.validation_gap: The required 10 test groups pass but do not cover WVO-INV-011; the current test helper encodes a mode-less valid manifest.

residual_risks: CodeGraph task query returned semantic mismatch; review used bounded source inspection fallback.
